g.aria-label: Title text 'At Primary D18, BG2's median follows the load-shift more than the lag-free K3 and the climatology, which cannot follow it. Rows: flagged days from day 7 after the first one. Normal level (estimated): median power in the 28 days before the first flagged day. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole origin days.'

text.tspan: At Primary D18, BG2's median follows the load-shift more than the lag-free K3 and the
climatology, which cannot follow it. Rows: flagged days from day 7 after the first one.
Normal level (estimated): median power in the 28 days before the first flagged day.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole origin days.
